name.note: Official API table uses this name; its current model is Jamba2 Mini.

family.note: Official family membership; lowercase is catalog normalization.

release_date.note: Launch date of Jamba2 Mini, which the current alias identifies; not the original Jamba Mini release.

open_weights.note: Developer checkpoint and downloadable weights are public.

license.note: Applies to Jamba2 Mini; do not inherit the older Jamba Open Model License.

parameters_b.note: Developer-reported nominal total, in billions; not an exact tensor inventory.

active_parameters_b.note: Developer-reported nominal active count, in billions, for this MoE variant; not inferred from total.

architecture.note: MoE is the routing classification. Backbone is hybrid Mamba SSM/Transformer; 32 layers, four attention layers, 16-expert top-2 routing on alternating layers.

context_window.note: Retained only as decimal normalization of API documentation stating 256K. Exact checkpoint configuration is 262144; the API page does not establish whether its enforced limit is 256000 or 262144.

reasoning.note: Means no dedicated extended-thinking model mode: launch positions Jamba2 without thinking-token overhead. It does not mean inability to perform reasoning tasks.

tool_call.note: Documented for Jamba API models and corroborated by the exact checkpoint serving example.

patch.description: AI21 Jamba2 Mini, a text-generation model with hybrid Mamba-Transformer layers and mixture-of-experts routing, released for enterprise question answering and instruction following.
patch.notes: Current documented jamba-mini alias maps to jamba-mini-2-2026-01 (Jamba2 Mini). Parameter counts are nominal developer figures: 52B total, 12B active. The MoE routing sits within a hybrid Mamba-Transformer backbone. API context is published as 256K; the downloadable checkpoint config specifies 262144, while 256000 is only the catalog decimal normalization. API callability was not tested.

sources.label: Official Jamba model details and alias mapping

architecture_backbone.note: Separate backbone from MoE routing so architecture=moe does not hide SSM/attention hybridity.

parameter_count_precision.note: 52B total and 12B active are published rounded counts.

context_window_scope.note: Retained scalar uses decimal normalization; add checkpoint_context_window=262144 if distinguishing deployment limits.

summary: Verified exact current API mapping to Jamba2 Mini and all fourteen fields with the context precision caveat. Fill Apache-2.0, 52B total/12B active, and MoE routing; explicitly retain hybrid Mamba-Transformer backbone. January 8, 2026 is supported by launch evidence. Hosted 256K versus checkpoint 262144 requires scope-aware display; no API inference request was made.
